forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {遊|あそ}んでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To engage in recreational activities for enjoyment. Used for children's play, games, and leisure activities.

definitions.gloss: to hang out, to spend time together
definitions.explanation: Casual way to describe spending leisure time with friends. Very common among young people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{遊|あそ}んでいます。
examples.english: The children are playing in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{遊|あそ}びました。
examples.english: I hung out with friends on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {遊|あそ}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: {遊|あそ}びに⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧/⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ = to go/come to hang out

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{遊|あそ}ぼう。
⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: I was playing with the dog.

examples.japanese: ⟦{砂場|すなば}→砂場：06326_sunaba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{遊|あそ}んでいる⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are children playing in the sandbox.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧{遊|あそ}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧？
examples.english: Can I come hang out next time?

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{遊|あそ}んだ。
examples.english: Yesterday I spent the whole day hanging out with friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暇|ひま}な→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{遊|あそ}ぼう⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Let's hang out together when you're free.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). No transitive pair. Pattern: Xで{遊|あそ}ぶ (play at X) or Xと{遊|あそ}ぶ (play with X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {遊|あそ}んでいる = 'is playing/hanging out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{遊|あそ}ぶ (hang out with friends)
・⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{遊|あそ}ぶ (play in the park)
・{遊|あそ}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (go to hang out/visit)
・{遊|あそ}び⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (come to visit/hang out)

The {遊|あそ}びに pattern is extremely common for casual social visits.
